📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #2 in the last 24h (prior: 4 alerts @ 16:25-17:01Z; this cycle: 15 alerts @ 17:11-17:59Z — 3.75× more in similar window).
Group: f42d48151e5f1c5e • channel: alert-frontend-errors • monitor 77419271 last_triggered 17:59:11Z

ES confirms same backend pattern: 827 Ocelot RequestTimedOutError warnings in 55min (17:10-18:05Z) vs 910 in the same window 24h ago = -9% — still steady-state, not a new incident. Sample path this cycle: /syncutil/syncwidget/proairkc/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync.

Escalation note: alert volume increased 4→15 cycle-over-cycle, but underlying backend rate is flat. Monitor 77419271 is amplifying because more individual accounts crossed its >40/5m threshold within a 48-min window — likely a function of which user sessions were active, not a worsening of the gateway timeout itself.

Recent deploys: 0 commits in 4h-before/30m-after across all six candidates (gateway, tables-fields, m-pui, sync-util, preferences, account). Sustained operational condition.
